scope.intended_task: predict future maintenance or component failure for real fleet vehicles

evidence.maintenance_block_reason: acquisition_run_id is absent; no split or model fit occurred.
evidence.maintenance_training_records_note: The recorded 55,998 is prepared candidate rows, not fitted training records.

candidates.name: EngineFaultDB
candidates.vehicle_or_component_type: Controlled laboratory C14NE spark-ignition engine; single engine

target.meaning: Four numeric laboratory engine-state/fault classes; numeric labels are not mapped to verified fault names.

group_identifiers.finding: Neither the CSV, preparation metadata, local inventory/manifests, nor README maps rows to runs. README describes one engine and laboratory collection, not row-level run boundaries.

candidates.leakage_safe_split: Not feasible from local evidence; row-random splitting is unsafe and no documented group keys exist.

task_assessment.fault_classification: Potential limited laboratory research task only, but blocked by unknown class mapping and missing run groups.

candidates.decision: Do not train for the requested task. Obtain authoritative original run/session metadata and label mapping before reconsidering laboratory classification.

candidates.name: Diesel OBD workbooks
candidates.vehicle_or_component_type: README claims multiple diesel vehicles; exact records and source are not independently verified
candidates.features: README lists 11 OBD PID signals, but workbook columns and their provenance require source-level verification.

target.claimed: README claims manually documented DTCs and healthy/fault labels.
target.meaning: No demonstrated row-level linkage from workbook features to vehicle-level DTCs/outcomes.

candidates.leakage_safe_split: Not established; provided train/test vehicle independence is unknown.
candidates.decision: Do not train until original acquisition files, labels, vehicle linkage, split semantics, and license are independently verified.

candidates.name: Vehicle Maintenance service records
candidates.vehicle_or_component_type: Car; two makes and four models in local records

target.meaning: Past/scheduled/service recommendation semantics are undocumented; no timestamps or confirmed future outcomes.

candidates.leakage_safe_split: Not feasible; slno is unique but is not documented as a vehicle key and event chronology is absent.
candidates.decision: Do not train; establish source, vehicle identity, service-date meaning, and future outcome labels.

candidates.name: KIT Automotive OBD-II
candidates.vehicle_or_component_type: Seat Leon model telemetry; one vehicle model represented in filenames

target.meaning: Road/traffic operating condition tags, not fault, maintenance, or repair labels.

candidates.leakage_safe_split: Session-level split is possible for descriptive signal studies, but there is no target outcome for maintenance evaluation.
candidates.decision: Telemetry-only; do not train a supervised maintenance model.

candidates.name: Navarra motorcycle telemetry
candidates.vehicle_or_component_type: Kawasaki Ninja 400 track motorcycle, one machine and one rider

target.meaning: No confirmed maintenance, fault, repair, loss-of-grip, or RUL labels. ECU control-cut codes are not fault labels.

candidates.leakage_safe_split: Continuity can be segmented by boot_id, but only one machine/rider and no labeled outcomes are present.
candidates.decision: Single-machine sensor analysis only; no failure inference.

candidates.name: Root engine-condition tables
candidates.vehicle_or_component_type: Engine-state measurements; source vehicle type unknown

target.meaning: Binary label; no source definition linking it to a confirmed fault or future maintenance outcome.

candidates.leakage_safe_split: Provided split is row-disjoint but cannot be established as group-disjoint.
candidates.decision: Do not treat as automotive fleet evidence without source, units, labels, groups, and license.

candidates.name: Unattributed Parquet

target.meaning: Ten observed values but no documentation, source, or verified semantics.

candidates.leakage_safe_split: Not feasible; group identity and temporal provenance are missing.

task_assessment.fault_classification: Not established due to unknown label semantics.

candidates.decision: Exclude until provenance, units, target definitions, group keys, and license are verified.

candidates.name: CVFFAD generated fault events
candidates.path: data/raw/Chinese Vehicle Fleet Fault Association Dataset/Chinese Vehicle Fleet Fault Association Dataset/fault_events.csv
candidates.related_vehicle_metadata: data/raw/Chinese Vehicle Fleet Fault Association Dataset/Chinese Vehicle Fleet Fault Association Dataset/vehicle_fleet.csv
candidates.vehicle_or_component_type: Generated event data presents eight vehicle-type categories

target.meaning: README describes generated fault-event and annotation records; not verified real fleet outcomes.

group_identifiers.event_or_run_id: event_id present; no acquisition-run metadata verified

candidates.leakage_safe_split: Vehicle grouping is syntactically possible, but generated IDs and records do not establish an independent real-world fleet evaluation.
candidates.decision: Exclude for real/commercial fleet claims. Local DOI is placeholder and referenced license/provenance records are missing.

candidates.name: AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance
candidates.vehicle_or_component_type: Synthetic industrial machine tools, not road vehicles

target.meaning: Synthetic machine and component failure modes.

candidates.leakage_safe_split: Potential product-level holdout for the synthetic industrial dataset, not applicable to fleet vehicles.

candidates.name: NASA Li-ion battery aging
candidates.vehicle_or_component_type: Laboratory lithium-ion cells, not installed vehicle packs

target.meaning: Cycle capacity and documented 30% capacity-fade EOL criterion can support laboratory cell aging/RUL.

candidates.leakage_safe_split: Cell-disjoint split is conceptually possible after cycle-level preparation and duplicate-file removal.

task_assessment.maintenance_prediction: Lab-cell degradation/RUL research only; not vehicle fleet maintenance.

candidates.decision: Possible separate cell-aging research with reuse-term review; do not represent it as installed vehicle battery prediction.

candidates.name: Experimental Energy Characterization

target.meaning: No documented failure, maintenance, or RUL labels.

candidates.decision: Keep out of supervised training until source, labels, and identifiers are supplied.

candidates.name: LEVIN telematics
candidates.vehicle_or_component_type: Repository describes four-wheelers; local raw measurement export is absent
candidates.leakage_safe_split: Not applicable; no local measurement table.
candidates.decision: No training use until the data files and documented license are available.

evidence: Raw CSV columns contain Fault and 14 numeric signals only.
Prepared metadata contains counts/transformations but no row-to-run mapping.
README describes a single controlled laboratory engine but not row-level acquisition groups.
Raw inventory/manifests identify files and hashes, not CSV row acquisition sessions.
enginefaultdb_acquisition_run_id.prohibited_inference: Do not invent IDs from row order, labels, values, or timestamps.
enginefaultdb_acquisition_run_id.needed: Authoritative source-side acquisition logs or row-to-run mapping verified against the unchanged CSV.

recommendation.reason: No candidate combines real, provenance-verified fleet data, time-ordered confirmed maintenance/failure outcomes, and vehicle/component groups for independent evaluation.
future_data_requirements: Timestamped unit-defined telemetry and odometer readings
Trip/run/session IDs and preserved temporal order
Confirmed maintenance, inspection, fault, repair, replacement, and service outcomes
Explicit future prediction horizon or run-to-failure target with censoring semantics
Enough independent vehicles/failures for vehicle-disjoint time-aware holdout
Documented provenance, collection protocol, label meanings, missingness, and reusable license
Evidence of coverage across the intended vehicle types
recommendation.next_action: Obtain suitable fleet outcome records and authoritative group metadata, then reassess target definitions and leakage-safe evaluation before implementing a training script.

evaluation_design: Freeze vehicle/component-disjoint and time-aware holdout before preprocessing or model selection.
Compare most-frequent and simple domain baselines.
Report balanced accuracy, per-class precision/recall/F1, macro F1, confusion matrix, and appropriate PR-AUC/ROC-AUC.
Inspect target leakage, duplicates, calibration, class prevalence, and confidence intervals.
Bind report to exact dataset and artifact hashes.
Use prospective/time-forward labels for future-failure claims; name contemporaneous classification as fault classification.
